mainText: Good morning, Friday November 6th. Futures are mixed in a partial bounce after Thursday's sharp selloff. The S and P is up two tenths of a percent, the Nasdaq up one point four percent, and the Dow down one percent. The October jobs report is due at eight thirty this morning. The ten year Treasury yield is about four point eight five percent, up slightly from Thursday's close. In movers, Cloudflare is up twenty percent on strong earnings and raised guidance. J Frog is up twenty two percent as cloud revenue rose sixty percent. Chip stocks are rebounding, with Micron and A M D up eight percent, SanDisk up ten to twelve percent, and Nvidia up four percent. Airbnb is up twelve percent on a demand beat, while DraftKings is down twenty four percent after slashing guidance.
